description_zh: 一辆车（ego）在路口直行时追尾了因红灯停在前方同车道的 Waymo AV（v2）。报告显示后车移动、前车停止，属于典型的 rear-end 碰撞。

source_snippets: The Waymo AV was stopped in traffic for a red light on The Embarcadero southbound when a passenger car approached from behind and made contact with the rear of the Waymo AV.
Vehicle was: Stopped in Traffic (Vehicle 1), Vehicle was: Moving (Vehicle 2)
TYPE OF COLLISION VEH 2: C. REAR END
MOVEMENT PRECEDING COLLISION VEH 2: B. PROCEEDING STRAIGHT
evidence.reason: 后车（丰田凯美瑞）在移动且追尾静止的前车，具备测试价值，故选为 ego；前车（AV）作为 NPC 以 stopped_ahead 表达，符合词汇表。
